title: 2026-10-22_XorDDoS_Incident_Response_Scenario_fea
description: Investigate and respond to a potential security incident involving the XorDDoS Trojan on a victim host.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The victim host in your network has exhibited unusual behavior, including unexpected outbound network connections and suspicious scheduled tasks. Your task is to investigate and respond to this potential security incident involving the XorDDoS Trojan.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- IP Address: 192.168.60.10
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter the passkey 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- IP Address: 192.168.60.10
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter the passkey 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the victim host for unauthorized or suspicious services that may indicate malware activity.
levels.solution: The service name associated with the suspicious activity is network-diagnostics.service. Check running services and their associated processes to identify any anomalies. Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and their associated processes to identify any anomalies.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all services.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service | grep -i network' to filter services related to network diagnostics.

levels.title: Examine Scheduled Tasks
levels.content: Determine if any scheduled tasks or timers are responsible for automatically executing potentially malicious code on the victim host.
levels.solution: The name of the timer or task responsible for the scheduled execution is network-diagnostics.timer. Examine the systemd timers and services to find any unusual scheduled tasks. Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all timers.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and services to find any unusual scheduled tasks.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all timers.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run the command 'systemctl list-timers | grep -i network' to filter timers related to network diagnostics.

levels.title: Locate Malware Components
levels.content: Locate files installed by the malware on the compromised host to understand the extent of the infection.
levels.solution: The filename of a key component installed by the malware is net-diag-installer.sh. Search for hidden or unusual directories and files that may contain malware components. Use the command 'find / -name "net-diag-installer.sh" 2>/dev/null' to locate the file.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search for hidden or unusual directories and files that may contain malware components.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'find / -name "net-diag-installer.sh" 2>/dev/null' to locate the file.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run the command 'find / -name "net-diag-installer.sh" 2>/dev/null | grep -i net-diag' to filter files related to network diagnostics.
